form:FormGroup.label: Kind
form:FormGroup.helpText: The kind of destination this rule permits.

form:FormGroup.label: Destination
form:FormGroup.helpText: A URL, a file path, an email address, or a host and port, as the kind needs. It is tidied before it is stored, so https://Example.com:443/a/../b is kept as https://example.com/b.

form:FormGroup.label: Match
form:FormGroup.helpText: Exact permits only this destination. Prefix permits anything inside it, a whole part at a time, so /data/out permits /data/out/a but not /data/out-old. An email address can only match exactly.

form:FormGroup.label: Reason
form:FormGroup.helpText: Why this destination is permitted. It is required, so that the next person to read the list knows.
Untick to keep the rule but stop it permitting anything.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Whether the rule is in force.

form:FormGroup.label: Test
form:FormGroup.helpText: Asks the server how it would treat this destination, using the rules as they are stored now, without sending anything.
